name: acyclovir
bcs_notes: Solubility 1.3 mg/mL @25C: dose 400mg needs ~308mL (>250mL BCS high-solubility threshold pH1.2-6.8). Classified as III in some sources (moderate permeability) and IV in others. Retained as BCS III per Kristl 1999 / Lindenberg 2004 with explicit borderline documentation; reviewer flag expected.
bcs_sources: Kristl et al. J Pharm Sci 1999
Lindenberg et al. Eur J Pharm Biopharm 2004
